original_question: On which chromosome is the gene that, when mutated, leads to adenosine monophosphate deaminase (myoadenylate deaminase) deficiency type 1 located?

final_qi.question: On which chromosome is the gene that, when mutated, leads to adenosine monophosphate deaminase (myoadenylate deaminase) deficiency type 1 located?
final_qi.long_answer: Myoadenylate deaminase (adenosine monophosphate deaminase) deficiency type 1 is caused by mutations in the AMPD1 gene, which is mapped to the short arm of chromosome 1 (region 1p13).
